{{Nihongo|'''Intergalactic Hitman Gigantes'''|ギガンデス||11}}:

==History==
An [[Alienizer]] from the planet Bileeza. Charged with wide-area homicide, he is an old academy buddy of [[Houji Tomasu|Houji]]'s Veeno Sunrc, who retired from the Space Police and reconfigured his body into a gun-for-hire, having grown disenchanted by the life of a Deka and lured into the life of a criminal by the money he is able to earn with his skills. Hired by [[Kajimerian Ben. G]] to assassinate [[Doggie Kruger]]. He is Deleted by [[DekarangerRobo]]'s Justice Flasher after using some drugs to grow gigantic, but not before revealing [[DekaBase]] info to [[Rainian Agent Abrella]]. As he attempted to murder Doggie Kruger and he killed multiple important people on other planets, the Supreme Space Court already approved his deletion and [[Judgement]] was thus unnecessary.{{Storylink|Episode. 11: Pride Sniper}}

==Personality==
Gigantes is very heartless, cruel, callous and greedy Alienizer, completely obsessed with earning as much money as possible. He never hesitates to kill in order to achieve his goals, thus he has no regard for anyone.

==Powers and Abilities==
===Powers===
*'''Transformation''': Gigantes can change between his original form Veeno and his reconfigured form at will.
*'''Lightning Blast''': Gigantes could fire blue-colored lightning from the spikes on his shoulders.

===Abilities===
*'''Marksmanship''': Gigantes is an expert marksman.
*'''Hand-To-Hand Combat''': Gigantes is skilled in hand-to-hand combat.

===Weaknesses===
''to be added''

==Arsenal==
*'''Arm Gun''': Gigantes can equip a large silver-colored gun to his right arm.
*'''Growth Drugs''': Gigantes possessed a small container that contained red/yellow-colored drugs that allowed him to grow after eating them.

==Profile==
===Crimes===
*Murder
*Attempted murder
*Kidnapping

==Behind the Scenes==
===Portrayal===
*''to be added''

Gigandesconcept.png|Intergalactic Hitman Gigantes Concept Art

===Etymology===
*Gigantes is Greek for "giant" and is named after a race of giants that were fertilized by Gaia where they fought the Olympian Gods and Hercules during the Gigantomachy.
*His home planet is named after Billy the Kid.
*His name "'''Veeno'''" is named after {{Nihongo|Nobita Nobi|野比 のび太|Nobi Nobita}}, the main character of ''Doraemon'' series, who is stated to have great marksmanship.

==Notes==
*Gigantes is one of the few Alienizers that can enlarge themselves.

{{Nihongo|'''Dodon'''|ドドン}} is a Space Beast of the Great Star League Gozma.

==History==
A fat giant salamander-like Space Beast with a prehensile tail, known as the greatest hijacker of the universe. Possesses the ability to breathe fire and emit a knock-out gas from his body as well as create many smaller larva-like creatures that he houses around his body. Summoned while the Changeman return from a mission, he seizes control of their Shuttlbase, easily taking down the Changeman and the Dengeki Squadron on the ship and throwing all but Change Mermaid off the ship. Sayaka is forced to fight him long enough for Tsurugi to make his way back to Shuttlbase (after avoiding nearly every Gozma threat thrown at him) and land it safely on the ground. The team defeat his mini-minions before a combination of all five of their attacks and a Power Bazooka destroy him. After being rebuilt by Gyodai, the Changeman throw missiles that Dodon ends up eating and then having explode in his mouth. Weakened, the Changeman throw Change Shield to weaken him further, then use Dengeki-ken first to slice off his tail, then finish him off completely.{{storylink|Dengeki Sentai Changeman: Shuttlbase! The Critical Moment!}}

}}{{Nihongo|'''SD World'''|SDワルド|Esu Dī Warudo}} is an SD-themed [[Worlds|World]] from the [[Kikaitopia Dynasty Tojitendo]] who was created from the SD [[Sentai Gears|Tojiru Gear]] that contained [[SDtopia]], the world where [[Ricky Goldtsuiker]] and [[Cutanner Goldtsuiker]] got their SD forms. After his death, his Tojiru Gear lasted another life by reforming a [[New Kudaitests|New Kudaitest]] into [[Great SD World]].

==History==
The SD World appeared at a takoyaki stand where the World Pirates manage to avoid his D Ball as it destroys the table. As Zocks asked about him, the SD World answered by demonstrating his SD Spark by turning the residents as well as Gaon and Vroon into SD-variant of themselves. With that, Zocks transformed into Super Twokaizer and started battling the SD World.

During the battle, the rest of the Zenkaiger showed up and joined the fight. Kaito tries to assist Zocks, but he shoved him out and SD World tries to hit Kaito, but he dodges and grabbed the D Ball only for the SD World to swing his  D Ball causing the SD civilian as well as Vroon and Gaon flying to various places. With that, Magine and Juran got distracted which gives the SD World the opportunity to turn them into their SD form. Flint tries to help out in the fight, but a [[Kudaiter]] comes out behind her only for Zocks to save Flint and this gives the SD World to transform her into SD form only for Zocks to sacrifice his Geardalinger which shrank into a tiny size. Overwhelming in battle, they used the Dairanger Sentai Gear and use ShishiRanger's illusion powers to retreat.

Later, the SD World appears at a park as he was chasing more civilians until Zocks showed up now very determined to destroy the SD World. The battle was on as both Zocks and the SD World were fighting in a shallow pond and Zocks is being overwhelmed by SD World. To make matters worse, the SD World brought in more [[Kudaks]] as well as a pair of Kudaiters to overwhelm him but Kaito along with the SD teammates to assist the Zocks while the civilians and Yatsuda search for the other SD victims. With that, the team transformed and battled him. However, the SD World shrugs them to the side as he was about to change Zocks into an SD but was saved by Cutanner and Ricky. Flint made some "tiny" adjustments to Zocks's Geardalinger as he can finally transform and help the Zenkaigers out. During the fight, both Juran and Gaon manages to hack and slash the first Kudaiter, Vroon drilled a huge hole and Magine used her magic to summon a banana peel causing the second Kudaiter to slip and fall down the hole to the point of its destruction. Zocks changes to his Ohren form as he delivers some beatings towards the SD World. He tries to retaliate by using his SD Spark, but Cutanner blocks the shot instead. After that, the SD World is then destroyed by Twokaizer's Chouriki Star Knuckle, thus reverse the spell.

====Abilities====
*{{Nihongo|'''SD Spark'''|SDスパーク|SD Supāku}}: SD World has the ability to alter one's form into a robotic SD form (which works on both humans and Kikainoids) by shooting a beam from his head. Additionally, he can affect weapons, as he managed to shrink the [[Geardalinger]] to such an extent that it was rendered practically useless. The only downside is that the beam has no effect on those who are already in SD form, such as [[Ricky Goldtsuiker|Ricky]] and [[Cutanner Goldtsuiker]].

===Design===

===Etymology===
*"SD" is an abbreviation of "Super Deformed", a design genre of which is very popular in Japan.

==Notes==

**SD World's voice actor, [[Naoya Uchida]], previously portrayed [[Tatsuya Midorikawa|Tatsuya Midorikawa/Denzi Green]] in ''[[Denshi Sentai Denziman]]''.
*SD World’s D Ball would be later repainted to become the {{KR|Raise Chain Array}} in ''{{KR|Kamen Rider Geats}}''.
